description: howtoai-dev safety hooks: dev-test-first keeps the test-first order and blocks CI edits during test stages; dev-safe-target denies production markers and asks before destructive commands and migration edits. dev-test-first is silent unless a change is at a test or build stage; dev-safe-target applies deny markers wherever the dev settings name them, and its destructive checks only in workspaces with project dev settings.

hooks.command: F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dev_test_first.py"; if command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 -I -B "$F"; else exec python3 -I -B "$F"; fi
F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dev_safe_target.py"; if command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 -I -B "$F"; else exec python3 -I -B "$F"; fi
